Suspected Drones Near Amritsar Airport Cause Flight Diversions

Suspected drone-like objects were sighted near the runway of Sri Guru Ram Dass Ji International Airport in Amritsar on Sunday night, prompting security agencies to go on high alert. Air Traffic Control (ATC) diverted seven flights bound for Amritsar to Delhi and Chandigarh as a precautionary measure. The sightings occurred in the operational area and around the runway, leading to the alert.
